Solaris invented a heliobeam, a weapon capable of cataclysmic destruction. It's up to secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) to rescue Solaris before he is brainwashed into using the heliobeam. Helm poses as a gangster, seducing Solaris' daughter, Suzie (Ann-Margret), along the way.

programme.title: All Ashore
programme.desc: Sailors Joe (Dick Haymes) and Skip (Ray McDonald) habitually take advantage of their shipmate, Moby (Mickey Rooney), who's robbed after they take him to a shady bar. When they have no money to go to Catalina Island, Calif., Joe arranges their travel by volunteering the clueless Moby to work on the ship. Skip later meets a glamorous dancer (Peggy Ryan), while Joe woos a nightclub owner (Jody Lawrance). Moby decides to leave, but finds himself coming to the rescue of a beautiful heiress.

programme.title: A Night to Remember
programme.desc: In this suspenseful comedy, Nancy Troy (Loretta Young) and her mystery-author husband, Jeff (Brian Aherne), move into a dark basement apartment in New York City's Greenwich Village, in hopes of stirring up writing inspiration. When their neighbors begin acting oddly and one of them turns up dead, Nancy and Jeff must uncover a murder mystery in their own building, with a number of suspects lurking about, including the creepy Mrs. Devoe (Gale Sondergaard).

programme.title: The Taming of the Shrew
programme.desc: In this film adaptation of the classic Shakespeare play, Grumio and Hortensio both long to wed the same beautiful young woman. Unfortunately, her wealthy father will not let his daughter marry unless her hot-tempered sister, Katharina, also has a suitor. Luckily, the slovenly Petruchio is looking for an affluent woman to marry, so Grumio and Hortensio pay him to try to woo the extremely volatile Katharina.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.title: Arrival

Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. programme.title: Charles Lloyd, Keith Jarrett, Cecil McBee & Jack DeJohnette
programme.sub-title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound. Lloyd moves from hard swing to subtle ballads, blending gorgeous textures and Eastern influences. This 1966 recording features Lloyd's quartet, accompanied by Keith Jarrett (piano), Cecil McBee (double bass) and Jack DeJohnette (drums), playing some of Lloyd's own compositions.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, "The Best Is Yet To Come," "Fly Me to the Moon," and his signature song "I Left My Heart in San Francisco."

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Florian Boesch, Iwona Sobotka, Robert Murray & Anna Stephany
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). Engineered with unmatched symphonic finesse, Beethoven set aside ruminations on fate and heroism to compose his utterly musical and wholly satisfying Ninth Symphony. It is a monumental work, renowned for its innovative use of a chorus and vocal soloists in the final movement, singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem "Ode to Joy". Premiered in 1824, it remains one of the most performed and recognizable pieces of classical music. This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Slipknot
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. "God Bless Ozzy Osbourne" tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd, Keith Jarrett, Cecil McBee & Jack DeJohnette
programme.sub-title: Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound. Lloyd moves from hard swing to subtle ballads, blending gorgeous textures and Eastern influences. This 1966 recording features Lloyd's quartet, accompanied by Keith Jarrett (piano), Cecil McBee (double bass) and Jack DeJohnette (drums), playing some of Lloyd's own compositions.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Modern Jazz Quartet
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre. Following concerts in Rotterdam and Amsterdam the days before, the Modern Jazz Quartet performed at Singer Concertzaal in Laren for Dutch TV on March 31, 1969. Composed of Milt Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums, the foursome plays with elegance and style.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, "The Best Is Yet To Come," "Fly Me to the Moon," and his signature song "I Left My Heart in San Francisco."

programme.title: Philippe Jordan, Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris, Choeur de l'Opéra national de Paris & Ricarda Merbeth
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven's final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l'Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Beethoven composed his last Symphony when his hearing had all but gone, between 1822 and 1824. Symphony No. 9 is the longest and most ambitious of Beethoven's symphonies. Most striking is the piece's finale movement, which includes a choir and four vocal soloists singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem ‘An die Freude' (Ode to Joy). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Florian Boesch, Iwona Sobotka, Robert Murray & Anna Stephany
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). Engineered with unmatched symphonic finesse, Beethoven set aside ruminations on fate and heroism to compose his utterly musical and wholly satisfying Ninth Symphony. It is a monumental work, renowned for its innovative use of a chorus and vocal soloists in the final movement, singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem "Ode to Joy". Premiered in 1824, it remains one of the most performed and recognizable pieces of classical music. This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Rob Zombie
programme.sub-title: Rob Zombie: The Zombie Horror Picture Show
programme.desc: The Zombie Horror Picture Show is the first concert film by Groove Metal artist Rob Zombie, released May 19, 2014 on DVD and Blu-ray.

programme.title: Slipknot
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. "God Bless Ozzy Osbourne" tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: A Day in Big Sur 1
programme.desc: Transport your senses to the rugged yet exquisitely beautiful Big Sur coast of California to relax & absorb the healing sights and sounds of McWay Falls from a unique and rare perspective. Filmed more than a decade ago and remastered for maximum color and quality, "A Day in Big Sur" showcases the timeless beauty of this magical destination and attempts to truly capture the spirit of this natural paradise through the use of 50+ artistically framed video perspectives - all featuring real stereo nature sounds for an immersive relaxation experience.

programme.title: Cámara oculta
programme.desc: Cuando un reportero ganador de un Premio Pulitzer es asesinado en un hotel en Barcelona, su hermano Dan Kovacks comienza su propia investigación, descubriendo pruebas de que su hermano estaba a punto de hacer pública la existencia de un complot internacional bajo el nombre de "Mega-Bill". Una falsificación casi perfecta del billete de 100 dólares estadounidense. Pero los orígenes de la conspiración van más allá de la falsificación de divisas y podría provocar una guerra nuclear entre varios países de gran poder. ¿Quién trabaja para quién? ¿En quién puede confiar Dan?

programme.title: La rodilla de Clara
programme.desc: Jerome, un escritor de mediana edad, intenta conquistar durante sus vacaciones a una joven de diecisiete años que tiene novio. Instigado por su amiga novelista, inicia una operación de seducción que tiene mucho de afirmación personal.

programme.title: Insignificancia
programme.desc: Albert Einstein se encuentra en Nueva York para dar una charla sobre su último trabajo. Cuando se retira al hotel, encuentra a Marilyn Monroe en su habitación. La actriz y el científico conversan sobre temas como la teoría de la relatividad, el sexo o la política. La situación se complica cuando irrumpen en la habitación el senador McArthy y Joe DiMaggio, ex marido de Marilyn.

programme.title: El moderno Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Keaton es un proyeccionista que sueña con ser detective cuando, milagrosamente, se encuentra dentro de la película que está proyectando. Allí intentará salvar a su amada de las garras del villano. Una de las más aclamadas cintas de cine mudo llena de gags visuales y con un portentoso Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Encubridora
programme.desc: Vern Haskell recorre todo el Oeste en busca del hombre que violó y mató a su prometida. Alguien le dice que quizá lo encuentre…

programme.title: El manantial de la doncella
programme.desc: Suecia, siglo XIV. La joven e inocente Karin, hija de ricos padres terratenientes, es brutalmente violada y asesinada por unos pastores después de que su media hermana haya invocado una maldición pagana. Por un extraño giro del destino, los asesinos piden comida y refugio a los padres de la niña muerta, quienes, al descubrir la verdad, exigen una escalofriante venganza.

programme.title: HANNIBAL: EL ORIGEN DEL MAL
programme.desc: El joven Hannibal empieza a tramar una venganza después de que su hermanita sea asesinada durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Basada en la novela de Thomas Harris.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Un médico británico lucha contra una epidemia de cólera en un pequeño pueblo chino, mientras está atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: El Vendedor de Sueños
programme.desc: Un mendigo salva a un psiquiatra y se convierte en gurú viral, inspirando a muchos con su sabiduría.

programme.title: Donde está el Truco
programme.desc: Arturo hereda un circo en quiebra y dos niños —uno con superpoderes—, cambiando y salvando su vida.

programme.title: Escribir lo Imposible

programme.title: 97 Minutos

programme.title: Revuelo en las Aulas
programme.desc: Estudiantes de secundaria se unen contra la censura de un director opresivo.

programme.title: El Club de la Lucha
programme.desc: Un joven que lleva una vida gris y rutinaria conoce en un avión a Tyler Durden, un vendedor de jabón que cree que la autodestrucción es lo único que hace que la vida merezca la pena. Ambos deciden formar un club secreto de lucha donde descargar sus frustraciones.

programme.title: Warrior (2011)
programme.desc: Warrior cuenta la inspiradora historia de una familia separada que encuentra redención en el sitio menos esperado... un ring de artes marciales mixtas.

programme.title: El agente
programme.desc: En el año 2030, el mundo se encuentra en perenne estado de recesión económica y se enfrenta a problemas medioambientales. Todos los ciudadanos improductivos son exiliados a una colonia.

programme.title: La historia interminable
programme.desc: Mientras se esconde de los abusones en el desván del colegio, un chico descubre un mundo extraordinario de fantasía a través de un libro mágico titulado La historia interminable.

programme.title: El último verano
programme.desc: Anne, una brillante abogada que vive con su esposo Pierre y sus hijas, entabla gradualmente una relación apasionada con Theo, el hijo de Pierre de un matrimonio anterior, poniendo en peligro su carrera y su vida familiar.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Una fatídica noche, en un pequeño teatro regional inglés durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de actores en gira representan la obra "El rey Lear" de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Vega conoce a alguien que devolverá el color a su vida.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan a la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: La gran enfermedad del amor
programme.desc: Kumail y Emily se enamoran, pero las diferencias culturales y la familia complican su relación.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: Zoe
programme.desc: Dos compañeros en un revolucionario laboratorio diseñan la tecnología que mejora y perfecciona relaciones románticas. Mientras su trabajo progresa, sus descubrimientos se hacen más profundos.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea, una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida. Cuando todo el mundo multiplica sus atenciones hacia ella y empieza a recibir cada vez más ayuda, no le queda otra salida que mantener la mentira durante nueve meses.

programme.title: Fiebre de boda
programme.desc: Dahlia Marchand, la más popular novelista romántica, le gusta ser casamentera, y está decidida a ayudar a su adorable editora a encontrar al "Señor Perfecto" para ella.

programme.title: Sexy beast
programme.desc: Tras haber pasado una temporada entre rejas, Gal Dove vive ahora felizmente retirado en un chalet de la Costa del Sol española, junto a su mujer, a quien adora. Sin embargo, su felicidad se empaña con la llegada de Don Logan, un antiguo compinche que intenta convencerle de que vuelva a Londres para un último gran golpe.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Un volcán inactivo en las profundidades de un bosque en Turquía guarda un secreto mortal: un nido de huevos de Pterodactyl perfectamente conservados y listos para salir del cascarón. Pronto el pasado y el presente colapsan, provocando nefastas consecuencias para la humanidad. Una unidad militar de operaciones especiales será quien luchará contra el enemigo prehistórico.

programme.title: Misión oculta
programme.desc: Noviembre de 2001: dos meses después del 11-S, un agente de la CIA dirige un escuadrón de las Fuerzas Especiales estadounidense…

programme.title: Los bicivoladores
programme.desc: Tres jóvenes tienen el bicicross como afición. Un día, tras un accidente sus bicicletas quedan destrozadas. Para sacar dinero se les ocurre pescar almejas y encuentran un paquete que les traerá problemas...

programme.title: La mirada del amor
programme.desc: Cinco años después de perder el amor de su vida, Nikki se enamora de nuevo a primera vista. Tom es el hombre de sus sueños un atractivo profesor de arte con un gran corazón, sonrisa amable y mucha vitalidad. Su parecido físico con Garrett, su difunto marido, es asombroso. Seducida por la oportunidad de volver a vivir su primer amor verdadero, Nikki se sumerge en un mundo de fantasía con Tom como Garrett, sabiendo que tarde o temprano deberá revelar la verdad.

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos

programme.title: El Poder de un Sueño

programme.title: Charlie & Boots
programme.desc: Padre e hijo viajan para cumplir su ambición de toda la vida: pescar en el extremo norte de Australia.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Rockero rescata a su esposa secuestrada en Chile.

programme.desc: Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela.

programme.title: Si fuéramos los últimos
programme.desc: A la deriva en su averiado transbordador espacial y con pocas esperanzas de ser rescatados, dos astronautas discuten si es mejor pasar los días que les quedan como amigos o algo más. El roce hace el cariño y las chispas cada vez van más en aumento…

programme.title: Pequeñas cosas dulces
programme.desc: Entre sus obligaciones como alcaldesa y su papel como maestra en el pequeño pueblo de Kerguen, los días de Alice están realmente ocupados. Emile, una explosiva sexagenaria que por fin ha decidido aprender a leer y escribir.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Coffee Wars
programme.desc: Una barista vegana se enfrenta al mundo en el Campeonato Mundial de Baristas.

programme.title: ¿Qué Pasó Anoche?
programme.desc: Dos parejas que se conocen una noche en un bar y se sienten atraídas mutuamente. El juego de seducción comienza, pero en el largo camino entre el local y el dormitorio, la realidad se va abriendo paso.

programme.title: ¡Vaya vacaciones!
programme.desc: Para compensar el poco tiempo que pasa con su mujer e hijos, Bob Munro les promete un viaje a Hawai. Pero, en el último momento, cambia de idea y decide hacer una ruta por Colorado en caravana. Durante el trayecto, lleno de contratiempos, conocerán a los Gornicke, una familia con la que entablarán amistad.

programme.title: ¿Cuándo Llegamos?
programme.desc: Nick , un joven operador está deseando conseguir pedirle una cita a una mujer atractiva, Suzanne, de la que está locamente enamorado. Después de esperar un largo tiempo parece que el momento más esperado para Nick está a punto de llegar. Suzanne se encuentra atrapada en Vancouver y necesita a alguien que pueda recoger a sus hijos y llevarles hasta ella, Nick se ofrece para ser esa persona sin dudarlo, pero lo que no sabe es que para ellos ningún hombre es lo suficientemente bueno para su madre. El viaje que Nick se imaginaba no tendrá nada que ver con el que les espera, ya que acabará siendo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: Pampa salvaje
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un capitán del ejército intenta domar las llanuras abiertas de Argentina, dominadas por los indios y los bandidos. Para ello, el capitán trae a un grupo de mujeres para mantener contentos a sus soldados.

programme.title: Guerrero cheyenne
programme.desc: En su viaje hacia Oregón, Matthew y Rebecca se detienen en un puesto fronterizo donde un malentendido con los Cheyenne desencadena una tragedia. Rebecca y un guerrero herido, Hawk, son los únicos supervivientes. Con el invierno acercándose, ambos deberán superar sus diferencias para sobrevivir.

programme.title: 500 $, vivo o muerto
programme.desc: Un pie tierno se convierte en cazarrecompensas con la esperanza de labrarse un futuro mejor para él y su nuevo amor.

programme.title: Allá en el bajio
programme.desc: Tres bandidos se disputan unas tierras que podrían convertirse en el lugar perfecto para construir un hotel. Pero detrás de la ambición y el conflicto se esconde una lucha que pondrá a prueba sus intereses y cambiará el destino de los campesinos.

programme.title: La copa
programme.desc: Drama ambientado en la carrera de caballos de la Copa de Melbourne de 2002. Cuenta la historia de Damien Oliver (Stephen Curry), un jinete que ganó el trofeo con el caballo Media Puzzle, sorteando numerosas dificultades, gracias al apoyo del entrenador irlandés Dermot Weld (Brendan Gleeson).

programme.title: Pasos firmes
programme.desc: Gustavo, un joven corredor ciego, pierde a su compañero de entrenamiento y comienza a entrenar con Dany, un chico que enfrenta una vida difícil, mientras ambos descubren la fuerza de la amistad y la superación personal.

programme.title: Flor de Azúcar
programme.desc: Un joven campesino se ve obligado a huir por matar involuntariamente a un guardia abusivo. Tras un año entero escondido en una remota isla pesquera, decide regresar a su campo y reunirse con su mujer y sus hijas.

programme.title: Yo, mi ex y sus secuestradores
programme.desc: Carlota, arquitecta perfeccionista presionada por sus abuelos y su trabajo, rompe con su novia Bárbara tras una pelea. Esa misma noche, Bárbara es secuestrada por una banda torpe y violenta. Ahora Carlota deberá enfrentarse a los secuestradores para salvarla, en una comedia negra llena de sangre, caos y humor retorcido.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: Carmen
programme.desc: La naturaleza libre y enigmática de una mujer llamada Carmen, su belleza meridional, su carácter arrebatado y pasional, hacen que el sargento José se convierta en víctima y protagonista de acontecimientos extraordinarios.

programme.title: El apóstata
programme.desc: Premio FIPRESCI del Festival de San Sebastián 2015. "El apóstata" es una comedia dramática que repasa las cicatrices de un joven que desea emanciparse de aquello que se escapa de su control, a la vez que dispara contra sí mismo y con un afán cínico en algunas cuestiones de fe, de culpa y de deseo.

programme.title: El sueño de Valentín
programme.desc: 1960, Buenos Aires. Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela. Su madre desapareció cuando él tenía tres años y su padre es un hombre descontrolado e incapaz de asumir responsabilidades. Valentín es un niño solitario que busca constantemente amor y cariño.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Paul Dean has created a deadly parasite that is now attached to his stomach. He and his female companion, Patricia Welles, must find a way to destroy it while also trying to avoid Ricus, his rednecks, and an evil government agent named Merchant.

programme.title: The Food of the Gods
programme.desc: A group of friends travel to a remote Canadian island to hunt, only to be attacked by giant killer animals which have populated the place.

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: Devil's Gate
programme.desc: La localidad de Devil's Gate, en Dakota del Norte, hace honor a su nombre: en ella ocurren sucesos extraños, como la desaparición de Maria y de su hijo, investigada por una agente del FBI. Todas las pistas apuntan al taciturno esposo de Maria, pero el caso no tarda en revelar algo terrible bajo su superficie.

programme.title: Un misterio para Aurora Teagarden: El juego del gato y el raton
programme.desc: Aurora Teagarden volvera a enfrentarse a la resolucion de un nuevo crimen cuando un misterioso criminal empieza a dejarle enigmaticas pistas.

programme.title: H4ZARD
programme.desc: La historia gira en torno a Noah, que quiere muchísimo a su novia, a su hija y a su coche, pero, tras aceptar un trabajo como conductor, se ve envuelto en una carrera que le hará perder o bien la vida, o bien a su familia, o bien su querido coche.

programme.title: Rescate en Afganistán
programme.desc: Un comando de las operaciones especiales, liderado por el experto francotirador Jake Chandler, es enviado a un poblado de Afganistan para rescatar a un congresista capturado por los talibanes. La misión es un éxito, pero Jake, se queda en el campo de batalla para salvar a un soldado herido.

programme.title: Altitud
programme.desc: Una agente del FBI es castigada y enviada a un trabajo de administrativa en Washington DC después de desobedecer a sus mandos en una negociación con rehenes. En el avión que le lleva a Washington conoce a un apuesto hombre de negocios que le ofrece una recompensa si le ayuda a bajar del avión.

programme.title: Juego sucio en Las Vegas
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar

programme.title: Infalible
programme.desc: Kevin, Rob y Sam son miembros de un grupo que, sólo en teoría, planea asaltos perfectos, como hobby, sin la menor intención de llevarlos a cabo. Un gángster encuentra parte de su material de trabajo y decide chantajearlos para que realicen un robo millonario.

programme.title: Tierra Marciana
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos deben averiguar cómo detener la tormenta de arena que se dirige hacia ellos.

programme.title: El último Sharknado Ya era hora
programme.desc: Gil envía a su padre Fin atrás en el tiempo para evitar que empiecen los Sharknados.

programme.title: Fight to the Finish
programme.desc: Un boxeador aficionado se gana un enemigo cuando se interpone entre su vecina de al lado y su ex maltratador.

programme.title: La batalla de los malditos
programme.desc: Tras brote mortal, Max Gatling guía a supervivientes y robots contra un ejército de infectados.

programme.title: Beowulf & Grendel: El Retorno de la Bestia
programme.desc: El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un troll. Su hijo Grendel jura venganza.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Un grupo de documentalistas se traslada a la selva amazónica para localizar a la tribu indígena de los Shirishama. Este grupo está formado por una directora de cine, Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez), un antropólogo, Steve Cale (Eric Stoltz), un encargado de sonido, Gary Dixon (Owen Wilson), un cámara, Danny Rich (Ice Cube), un narrador, Warren Westridge (Jonathan Hyde) y una productora, Denise Kahlberg (Kari Wuhrer). A ellos se les une Paul Sarone (Jon Voight), un misterioso ex-sacerdote convertido en cazador, que asegura saber dónde se encuentran los Shirishama, por lo que se convierte en su guía. Pero, en realidad, a donde les dirige es a la caza de un reptil único en el mundo: una inmensa serpiente anaconda de doce metros de largo.

programme.title: Armados y Peligrosos
programme.desc: Los ganadores de los Premios Emmy John Candy y Eugene Levy arremeten contra el mundo de la seguridad privada pero, por desgracia, ¡normalmente van en dirección equivocada! Cuando el torpe policía Frank Dooley (Candy) y el inepto abogado Norman Kane (Levy) pierden sus trabajos, comienzan a trabajar en la Guard Dog Security Company, donde los robos se producen justo debajo de sus narices.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

programme.title: El Arte De Robar
programme.desc: Crunch Calhoun, un acróbata motociclista de tercera, y ladrón de arte en sus ratos libres, se junta con su escurridizo hermano para robar uno de los libros más valiosos del mundo. Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.
